Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the disclosure of information on flood insurance coverage.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to flood insurance coverage; and adding a newsection to chapter 48.27 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.27 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every insurer must provide written notice at policy issuanceand annually thereafter to homeowner, condominium unit owner,residential tenant, and residential fire insurance policyholders thatclearly and conspicuously discloses that the policy does not coverdamage caused by flooding. The notice must also inform thepolicyholder how to contact the national flood insurance program("NFIP"), or one of the NFIP's agents, or both. (2) The following language satisfies the notice requirements ofthis section: "This policy does not cover damage to your property caused byflooding. The federal government offers flood insurance through theNational Flood Insurance Program to residents of communities that p. 1 SB 5417participate in its program. You can learn more about the NationalFlood Insurance Program at www.floodsmart.gov or by calling (888) 3799531." If the contact information for the NFIP or its agents changes afterthe effective of this section, then the current contact informationmust be inserted in this notice.
